summary: This guide covers the top-performing Toxin team against Mekkatorque, the Season 8 endgame boss in Rasp of Gears. Using a core setup of Serpentemis, Lothair, Sleight, Sacredeia, and Child of Chaos, the team achieves over 2.5 billion damage. Proper skill timings are critical: abilities must be synced to a 30-second recast rotation to hit the boss's summoned orbs and prevent desynchronization. For players struggling with survivability or lacking Child of Chaos, support substitutions like Reytah or Stegamoffyn can stabilize the fight.

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.note: Serves as the primary damage dealer against Mekkatorque, benefiting hugely from high Attack, Enlightenment, and Inspiration levels.

heroes.name: Lothair
heroes.note: Acts as the secondary DPS; should be built with high Attack, Enlightenment, and enough HP to leverage conversion gear sets.

heroes.name: Sleight
heroes.note: Inflicts Potent Medicine and shares 15% Attack and Defense to adjacent allies in the row when equipped with Everlasting Candleflame armor.

heroes.name: Sacredeia
heroes.note: Should hold the highest Accuracy on the team with Bone Resonance gear to share Accuracy across all allies, ensuring debuffs land.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.note: Provides passive and active cleansing, healing, and Attack Penalty II to keep the team alive without needing manual skill syncing.

heroes.name: Twitch
heroes.note: Can substitute for Lothair to support Serpentemis as the main carry if Lothair is missing.

heroes.name: Reytah
heroes.note: Can replace Child of Chaos or Sacredeia if additional healing and cleansing are needed to survive the boss.

heroes.name: Stegamoffyn
heroes.note: Provides an Attack aura and survivability boost if struggling to survive with a full-offensive lineup.

teams.note: Deals 2.5B+ damage using a 30s skill recast cycle for Lothair, Serpentemis, Sleight, and Sacredeia to match orb summons, while Child of Chaos remains on default timing.

tips: Set ultimate recasts to 30 seconds rather than 15 seconds to ensure damage cycles match the boss's summoned orb phases.
Equip Sleight with Everlasting Candleflame armor and position him in the center of a row to grant adjacent heroes bonus Attack and Defense.
Build the highest possible Accuracy on Sacredeia with Bone Resonance to boost the entire team's Accuracy and avoid debuff resists.
If dying before the timer ends, swap Sacredeia out for a second dedicated cleanser/healer like Reytah or Stegamoffyn.
title: Toxin Vs Mekkatorque! Endgame Boss S8 Dragonheir: Silent Gods x Dragonstride
